{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("Raw revenue examples:")
print(data['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for thousands separators
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print(f"Rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for the 999999.99 QA rows
qa_rows = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA rows (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_rows)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = data[data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Summary
print("\n--- Summary of Issues ---")
print(f"Total rows: {data.shape[0]}")
print(f"Rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")
print(f"QA rows (999999.99): {len(qa_rows)}")
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_count}")"}
